verdict: Quiet break. Van Dijk keeps calm on his future and five players are out or doubtful.

big.label: To Man United at Anfield, 22 Nov

posters.headline: Van Dijk: no panic over my future
posters.summary: His deal ends next summer. He says he wants to keep playing and there is nothing to report.

read.what: ESPN says Van Dijk told reporters 'Let's see. I'm not in any panic.' He said he wants to keep playing and, if he does not stay, 'I will go somewhere else', but 'there's nothing to report at the moment'. His contract runs out next summer after a two-year extension in April 2024.
read.context: Alisson is also in the last year of his deal and wants to stay. Two senior players on expiring contracts is a real squad-planning question, and both can talk to foreign clubs in January.
read.take: Opinion: this is calm, not a done deal either way. He did not rule out leaving, and no talks are reported for him. Watch for any club comment before the January window.

posters.headline: Injury list before Man United
posters.summary: Van Dijk, Szoboszlai, Gravenberch and Frimpong are all doubts or out. Bradley is close to training.

read.what: The report, citing the Evening Standard, says Van Dijk withdrew from the Netherlands squad and Szoboszlai (knee) awaits assessment with Hungary. Gravenberch (heel) is a major doubt and Frimpong has a new muscle injury. Bradley is close to group work. Leoni and Ekitike are targeted for December.
read.context: Liverpool host Man United on 22 November. The break gives the injured a fortnight, but a thin squad has little cover in midfield and at right-back.
read.take: Opinion: return dates in these round-ups are estimates, not club statements. I could not open the Evening Standard original, so treat the timings with caution. Watch the club's pre-match team news.

stories.headline: Man United reportedly set to sack Carrick
stories.summary: AFP says United lean towards dismissal but no final decision is made. Four names are linked.

read.what: AFP reports, citing unnamed 'reports on Tuesday', that Berrada and Wilcox lean towards sacking Carrick. The Glazers and Jim Ratcliffe would have the final say. Pochettino, Howe, Conte and Nagelsmann are linked. No club statement is in the article.
read.context: United visit Anfield on 22 November and have the break to find a replacement.
read.take: Opinion: this repeats earlier reporting and adds no club confirmation. A new manager would make United harder to predict. Watch for an official announcement.

nextMatch.teamNews: Van Dijk, Szoboszlai doubts; Gravenberch major doubt; Frimpong out. Sky lists 16:00 and 16:30.

xlist.headline: Van Dijk 'not panicking' over future
xlist.summary: Pearce shared The Athletic's report that Van Dijk is weighing whether this is his last year. ESPN carries the same quotes.

xlist.headline: Not ready for life after Alisson and Van Dijk
xlist.summary: An opinion piece argues the club has no ready answer if both leave, as each enters the final year of their deal.
